Zoe: Heads-up: regendiff CI failed for sdk-js after the typegen ordering change landed in #typegen-refactor. Tests show optional param re-ordering in generated method signatures.
Raj: ouch. paste the diff?
Zoe: ```diff
- function createJob(opts?: { priority?: number, metadata?: Record<string,string> })
+ function createJob(opts?: { metadata?: Record<string,string>, priority?: number })
```
Zoe: that flips param order inside the object type which breaks callers relying on exact shape checks in some internal sampleapps.
Priya: why would typegen change property ordering? JSON schema->TS should be stable. Did we change stable-sort behavior?
Connor: I tweaked the property-sorter to prefer alphabetical for consistency across languages (1753301210). But TS baseline tests assumed source-order preserved for compatibility.
Maya: CI bot shows semver guard flagged this as a breaking change: it treats object property reorder as a breaking structural change.
CI Bot: check/regendiff-semver-guard — FAILED (object property order change detected)
Raj: property order in plain JS objects is not semver-breaking normally, but our semver guard does a textual/type AST compare. We should relax the rule to ignore property order reorders that don't change types.
Priya: agree, but sampleapps still failing because some code does exact stringified comparisons in tests (ugh). We need a two-pronged fix: 1) restore previous deterministic property order for TS output and 2) make semver guard smarter to ignore reorders.
Connor: quick patch: revert alpha-sort for TS target only and add a test asserting original ordering for sampleapp schemas. Will open PR.
Maya: can we also add a post-regendiff sanitizer that normalizes ordering for semver diffing? So CI won't fail on irrelevant reorders.
Zoe: good idea. For now I reverted the refactor in the sampleapp pipeline and re-ran regen. Local regen diff is clean. Pushing hotfix branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/623
CI Bot: build/sdk-js-regendiff — SUCCESS (after revert)
Priya: follow-ups: update semver guard to run a semantic-aware comparator; add a unit test in typegen to pin property order for TS; add a note in the changelog script about harmless reorderings.
Raj: filed DEVEX-1088 for semver guard improvements and DEVEX-1089 for typegen ordering tests.
Connor: I'll submit the two small commits today. Thanks for the quick triage everyone. :rocket:
